payload.recallText: Joe and his sister were talking about a letter he received. He was not too excited about opening it as he thought it might be trouble and assumes it might be about him leaving the Central Baseball league. He then does a practice swing with his arms and knocks over a box of flowers that his mother was watering, getting water all over the floor. He then finds the letter on the floor, opens it and reads it and it from the manager of a team, stating that he would be getting drafted to St. Louis.
